assets.text_content: Sensitive civic data is protected by minimizing what the system needs.
Public-service navigation can involve sensitive personal information. Security is part of the product architecture—not a deployment afterthought.
Collect or retain only what is necessary for the requested civic purpose.
Citizen identities and privileged operational identities are separated.
Route-level + object-level enforcement, privileged-action auditing and data-scope restrictions.
Logs exclude or redact sensitive citizen data.  [INSERT FINAL REDACTION POLICY]
